summaryZh: Kaech 实验室研究免疫记忆形成的遗传、转录、空间和代谢调节，以及肿瘤代谢如何影响免疫细胞功能。团队还研究慢性感染和癌症中的 T 细胞耗竭，并应用遗传和蛋白工程方法改善免疫记忆。
researchQuestions: 肿瘤代谢的关键特征如何影响免疫细胞功能？
T细胞在耗竭过程中如何应对持续性信号？

evidence.quote: Currently, we are focused on the spatial and metabolic cues that dictate memory formation, while also applying the latest genetic and protein engineering approaches towards the development of better memory.
We are focused on understanding how key characteristics of tumor metabolism (e.g. hypoxia, fatty acid synthesis, eicosanoids) influence immune cell function.
What is still unknown are the particular dynamics of exhaustion, especially how T cells resolve chronic signals, and the metabolic regulation of exhaustion.
